question: Which identities as all-moving, Durvāsas, and Vāsava are attributed to the deity?
premises: The deity is addressed as Durvāsas
The deity is addressed as Vāsava
inference: The deity unites omnipresence with the identities of Durvāsas and Vāsava
plain_english: Homage to the one who moves everywhere; homage to Durvāsas; homage to Vāsava.
